validation.controls_present: Successful interactions with fixed16-step wait only; other controls are separate

controls.capture_limit: Manifest records movement and toggle assertions; it does not record an independent visible-door or distance assertion

visibility_audit.method: Reconstruct captured state before action6; compare stored RGB exactly; independently render door black and white with all other scene properties fixed.

bootstrap.method: The same eight-scene resample is applied to every arm, seed, protocol, wait duration and control type
bootstrap.interval_scope: Scene variation conditional on three fixed trained seeds; undefined zero-denominator replicates make that interval unavailable

comparison.limit: Provisional development point-estimate gates; no protected-test or frontier-quality claim

checkpoint_selection: Fixed completed training budget only; no validation selection
limit: Development evidence only; gates require complete matched three-seed results, all controls and the hash-bound visibility audit
